nebf6c47bf7.headline: Latvian Defence Forces to sign giant deal for armored vehicle procurement, Estonia steps aside and waits
nebf6c47bf7.summary: The Latvian Ministry of Defence will sign a large contract to purchase 6x6 armored vehicles from Finnish-Norwegian company Patria, with Estonia postponing its procurement.
nebf6c47bf7.why: Defense procurement contracts impact the defense industry and regional security spending, influencing related companies and government budgets.
